newsitem.title: CHINA: China satellite moves into new orbit successfully.
newsitem.headline: China satellite moves into new orbit successfully.

text.p: China's Dongfanghong-3 (East is Red) communications satellite has successfully moved into quasi-synchronous orbit after its launch on Monday, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
All systems of the satellite were running normally and the satellite would enter a synchronous orbit in a few days, it said.
The Dongfanghong-3 is a newly developed communications satellite with 24 C-band transponders and a life span of about eight years.

The successful launch aboard a domestic Long March-3A rocket was seen boosting China's ambitions to develop a world-class space industry and could help to cut insurance costs after a string of spectacular failures.

International satellite insurers had been waiting for the launch of the Dongfanghong-3, which followed the failure of two major launches last year, saying a third loss could further drive up inflated premiums on Chinese launches.
